# Add structured details and eligibility to activities

## Problem

Activities currently have only a description, a text schedule, a participant limit, and a participant list. Students and staff need enough structured information to decide who can join and what each activity offers.

## Proposed outcome

Extend activity records and the catalog UI with optional structured details such as activity type, instructor, location, eligible grades, shifts, learning outcomes, and program information.

## Acceptance criteria

- Activity data can represent the proposed details without requiring every existing activity to be rewritten at once.
- The catalog displays available details clearly and remains usable on mobile screens.
- An activity can specify eligible grades and, where applicable, school shifts.
- Missing optional details do not break existing activity cards or sign-up.
- Search, filters, and sorting remain tracked by existing issue #4 and are not duplicated here.
